title: Selection on one compact set: a subsequence along which ∫ f dμ_j converges for every continuous f with tsupport f ⊆ K
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact, and let (μ_j)_{j∈ℕ} be Borel measures on ℝ^P with sup_j μ_j(K) < ∞. Then there is a strictly increasing θ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ with tsupport f ⊆ K the real sequence (∫ f dμ_{θ(j)})_{j∈ℕ} converges to some c ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → ⨆ j, μs j K < ∞ → ∃ θ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono θ ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ K → ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs (θ j))) atTop (𝓝 c)
